title: App never creates the SQLite schema on startup
evidence: main.py has no init_db()/create_all/startup/lifespan call (grep found none); database.init_db() exists but is never invoked. Running `uvicorn main:app` per README then hitting /books raises 'no such table: books'. Tests pass only because test_main.py calls Base.metadata.create_all itself.
suggestion: Wire init_db() into a FastAPI lifespan/startup handler in main.py so the shipped app creates its tables.

title: README curl example uses an isbn that fails validation
evidence: README.md example isbn '978-0743273565' is 14 chars; schemas.py BookBase.isbn has max_length=13, so the documented POST would return 422.
suggestion: Use a 10-13 char isbn in the README example, or relax the isbn length constraint.

title: Validation returns 422 rather than the checklist's 400
evidence: schemas.py enforces required title/author via Pydantic; test_main.py:test_create_book_validation_error asserts 422. R9 says 'rejected (400)'; 422 is FastAPI-standard and still rejects invalid input, so R9 is met.
suggestion: No action required; noted for cross-run comparison.
